about: The optional parts of BUI: one table read by CMake (features.cmake: an option each), cargo (blenderui-sys/build.rs maps cargo features to those options and checks Cargo.toml lists them all) and `bui build` (bindings/node/features.js: which runtime an app needs). A part that is off costs no binary size; its API stays (it reports the part missing). One feature per line: build.rs reads it line by line.

features.name: png
features.doc: PNG images (Wuffs)

features.name: gif
features.doc: GIF images and animations (Wuffs)

features.name: bmp
features.doc: BMP images (Wuffs)

features.name: tga
features.doc: TGA images (Wuffs)

features.name: qoi
features.doc: QOI images (Wuffs)

features.name: jpeg
features.doc: JPEG images (libjpeg-turbo)

features.name: webp
features.doc: WebP images and animations (libwebp)

features.name: hdr
features.doc: Radiance HDR images

features.name: pnm
features.doc: PNM (PGM, PPM) images

features.name: tiff
features.doc: TIFF images (libtiff, with zlib's inflate; JPEG-in-TIFF through libjpeg-turbo)

features.name: exr
features.doc: OpenEXR images (OpenEXRCore and libdeflate), shown like Blender's Standard view transform

features.name: avif
features.doc: AVIF images and animations (libavif and dav1d)

features.name: jxl
features.doc: JPEG XL images and animations (libjxl, with Highway and Brotli; C++)

features.name: heic
features.doc: HEIC/HEIF images through the OS decoder, loaded at run time (WIC with the HEIF extensions, ImageIO, libheif): nothing vendored

features.name: svg
features.doc: SVG images (nanosvg, which the icons use anyway: no extra code)

features.name: video
features.doc: <video> through the OS decoders (Media Foundation, AVFoundation, GStreamer), loaded at run time

features.name: gpu
features.doc: GPU renderers: Direct3D 11 (Windows), OpenGL 3.3 (Linux); without it, the software raster only

features.name: freetype
features.doc: Text through the vendored FreeType like Blender's BLF (else stb_truetype); every bui build runtime has it, so text looks the same

features.name: anim
features.doc: Animation: GSAP-style and Motion-style tweens, timelines, springs and every easing (kit/intern/anim)

features.name: shell
features.doc: The desktop shell: tray icons and their menus, notifications, taskbar progress, recent files (kit/intern/shell; the system's libraries loaded at run time)

features.name: filebrowser
features.doc: Blender's File Browser (the filebrowser node and BK_file_dialog)

features.name: imgui
features.doc: Dear ImGui on BUI (C++; the blenderui-imgui crate and Python's blenderui.imgui turn it on)

features.name: a11y
features.doc: Screen readers: each window's accessibility tree, served to UI Automation (Windows) through AccessKit (the a11y/ crate; C builds run cargo for it)

features.name: lua
features.doc: Lua 5.4 host (bui-lua executable and bui.so/bui.dll loadable module)

runtimes.name: full
runtimes.doc: everything a JavaScript app can use
